description: Add tables in bulk — each gets its own permanent table-ordering QR code with its name printed under it. Either pass `names` (["Table 1","Terrace 2"]) or `count` with an optional `prefix` ("Table" → "Table 4", "Table 5", … continuing after the highest existing number). Names that already exist are skipped. Follow with export_qr_codes(purpose: table_ordering) to print them.

count.description: How many numbered tables to add

start_number.description: First number; default continues after existing ones

name: create_tables
title: Create tables
